query_ranking_non_implementation_confirm: result_rank_or_order and match_strength both carry in-schema descriptions disclaiming authoritative ranking or query engine behavior.
graph_traversal_non_implementation_confi: referenced_artifact and result_item references are declared source locators/ids; no path-computation, traversal-order, or query-parameter field exists.
